bar.label: Config apply
bar.applying: Applying the config on the device…
bar.dirty: The draft has changes that are not on the device yet

confirm.prompt: The config is applied. Confirm that the link is alive —
confirm.rollback: otherwise the daemon restores the previous one

clashApi.title: metabox added experimental.clash_api to the config
clashApi.description: Without that section the runtime screens have nothing to read. The section is already in the applied file — the change was made by metabox, not by you.

failure.rolledBack: No confirmation arrived — the previous config was restored

check.title: sing-box rejected the config — nothing was written to the device
check.exitCode: Exit code: {{code}}. The draft is kept, fix it and apply again.

diff.title: What goes to the device
diff.same: The draft matches the file on the device.
diff.changed: Changed lines: {{count}}. The rest of the file goes byte for byte.
diff.caption: Line by line difference between the draft and the applied config

history.title: Config history
history.description: The daemon keeps the ten most recent applied versions. A rollback runs the full cycle: binary check, write, restart and the confirmation window.
history.empty: The history is empty: the config has never been applied through metabox, so there is nothing to go back to.
